_comment: Agent lockout / rate-limit schedule. The dashboard renders a 'next reset' countdown per window (GET /api/limits) and a tokens-used-vs-cap bar (GET /api/agent_usage). LIVE data, when available, comes from the proxy's usage_limits.json (tools/llm-proxy/usage_limits.json) which captures real provider rate-limit headers for every pane routed through the proxy (Claude/Sonnet/GLM). Codex is direct (not proxied) so its windows stay manual here. Times are ISO-8601 UTC (trailing Z).
_cap_tokens_note: cap_tokens is the token budget for that rolling window (null = unknown; the dashboard then shows absolute tokens with a neutral bar instead of a % toward a cap). Fill in your real plan caps to get color-coded 'approaching limit' bars.
_policy: Prefer Codex lanes when Claude headroom is low (weekly especially). Throttle GLM (lighter packets, low concurrency) so it does not hit its plan cap.
